From today, Runna subscribers can use the brand-new "Adapt for Heat" feature, which automatically adjusts pace targets based on local temperature and humidity. Details are as follows.

Runna adds heat-aware training tool

The personalised running coach app Runna today announced three updates aimed at supporting users throughout their entire training cycle, covering everything from training in hot weather to post-race recovery.

The new "Adapt for Heat" feature launches today, and Runna will help users find cooler running windows, recommending adjusted pace targets based on felt temperature, workout duration, and the specific session.

"Adapt for Heat" displays colour-coded hourly weather forecasts, allowing users to quickly identify the most suitable time slots for running and plan accordingly.

Below is Runna's introduction to this new feature:

Runna also announced the relaunch of its "Post-Race Recovery Plan" feature. Once a user starts a race plan ranging from 5km to 50km, the system will automatically generate a corresponding plan. Runna's Head Coach, former Olympian Steph Kessell, said these plans are designed by professional coaches to help runners "reduce the risk of burnout or injury".

Lastly, the platform also previewed a brand-new feature called "Upcoming Plans" to be launched in August. Users can schedule multiple training plans in advance and seamlessly transition to the next one after completing one, making long-term training arrangements smoother.

Below is Runna's introduction to the "Upcoming Plans" feature:

Plan your whole year in minutes: Runners can string together races, milestone goals, and training phases, keeping the entire year's training in clear view. Zero admin between plans: No need to rebuild or start from scratch—when your current plan ends, your preferred training schedule, projected finish time, and current fitness level carry straight into the next plan. Flexible and fully in control: Every plan can be edited, swapped, or deleted at any time, so runners remain in complete control of their training experience. Built for progress: Every plan is designed by Runna's expert coaching team using proven training principles, supporting sustainable progress, recovery, and race-day preparation.
